NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:239 and deliverables/brickfall-breaker-arcade/2.0.5-openai-standard/check.py:11 (prior measured RewardKit 0.1.7 Likert(points=5) normalization (raw-1)/4; not bound to this input)
evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE. scoring.toml:1-3 gates render=0.0, constraints=0.0; each gate judge.toml has one binary criterion with aggregation all_pass. render (gates/render/judge.toml:23): an incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out, then the correct Recruiter password signs in to 'a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... without a fatal error. A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' This is the auth leg with its positive control (gates/render/prompt.md:9). constraints (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23): a Recruiter opens a unique job and adds a unique candidate through ordinary UI; the Observer in a NEW INDEPENDENT EMPTY browser context finds the job and exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' That is the backing leg and excludes a convincing dead/static/localStorage app (REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'). gates/constraints/prompt.md:9 rejects API-only writes and defines independence (a reload or second tab of the same context is rejected). Every leg is publicly required: password and Observer account instruction.md:17; job title/team/hiring manager/places 1-50 and candidate name/email/source starting at the bottom of Applied hireops_rules.md:27-35; Observer reads the board hireops_rules.md:18. Enforcement: score.py:41-48,83 (identical to template) gives reward 0 unless every gate score > 0 and exits 1; test.sh:213-227 then stops before the scored suite. IN-DIMENSION GATE IN EVERY SCORED PROMPT. functional/prompt.md:9-13 restates the same backing check (Recruiter UI create + Observer independent context) and 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0'; all 43 functional criteria are binary (43 [[criterion]], 43 type=binary). polish/prompt.md:9-12 has the same check and 'binary0 throughout'; 5/5 criteria are binary. visual/prompt.md:9-12 has the same check and 'minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'; 5/5 criteria are likert points=5 with anchors 1-5 (visual/judge.toml:18-30). harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 is pinned (tests/Dockerfile:31), and earlier measured evidence in this workspace records Likert(points=5).normalize = [0,.25,.5,.75,1], so raw 1 is zero. No scored prompt assigns partial credit on gate failure (the defect named in quality-checks.md:125). In addition, the functional floor 0.05 (scoring.toml:10-11) zeroes the whole reward if the functional in-dimension gate zeroes. NO SAME-ORIGIN. A grep of task/tests and instruction.md for origin/CORS/same-host finds only functional/judge.toml:200 (hro_stale_refused, unrelated 'identifies who changed it'). The gates require server-backed shared storage (independent-context readback), not same-origin; instruction.md:13 explicitly permits CDN fonts/scripts. COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS. (a) Broken app that might pass: a single-process app keeping jobs in server memory passes both gates but is not durable; that is correctly left to functional protocol D/hro_restart (the gate need not grade durability). A browser-only/localStorage app fails constraints because the Observer's fresh context cannot see the job. A static shell with seed JSON fails both (the created job is not visible elsewhere). An app that renders protected workspace data before sign-in: the template render gate's 'no protected data is visible before sign-in' leg was dropped from the task render criterion, so such an app could pass the render gate. It is graded as a scored outcome instead (functional hro_anonymous, functional/judge.toml:186-192: fresh no-credential context replays must get 401 and no data). Task criteria are task-specific and the auth leg (wrong password refused + correct password works) remains, so this is an observation, not a row-29 defect. (b) Conforming alternative that might fail: an app requiring team or source fields (the gate says 'a team'/'any source'; the scored-prompt restatement omits them but does not forbid filling required fields); an app with a different Observer UI ('another working staff account is acceptable'); an app where cards appear only after navigating to the job (the judge must 'find that same job' through the UI). None would be wrongly failed by the gate wording. RUNTIME. The indexed scripted golden run (hashes verified: workspace.cjs 76b51237..., results/workspace.json a424b50f...) shows the golden refusing a wrong password, signing in, opening a job and adding candidates via the UI (workspace.cjs:280-293), and an Observer in a separate browser.newContext reading the board (workspace.cjs:486-495); results 14 and 22 passed, page_errors []. This is a scripted Playwright driver, not the configured claude-code judge through playwright-mcp. RESIDUAL RISK (why risk=true): no configured gate/scored judge run on this frozen input exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading ... absent'). So it is not measured that the golden passes the judged gates or that the judge hard-zeroes a blank/static app. The independent-context recipe (browser_run_code_unsafe + page.context().browser().newContext() under --isolated in @playwright/mcp 0.0.79) is evidenced only by another task's run, not on this input. Likert normalization is evidenced by earlier workspace checks, not re-run here (rewardkit is not installed locally).
